definitions.explanation: The act of bathing, especially soaking in a bathtub or hot spring. More formal than お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}る, often used in written instructions, medical contexts, and facility signage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入浴|にゅうよく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Take a bath before the meal.

examples.japanese: {入浴|にゅうよく}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}→温泉旅館：25209_onsenryokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入浴|にゅうよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: At this hot spring inn, you can enjoy bathing in an open-air bath.

notes:
A formal word for bathing. In everyday conversation, ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入浴|にゅうよく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (take a bath)
- {入浴|にゅうよく}{剤|ざい} (bath salts/additives)
- {入浴|にゅうよく}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (bathing time)
- {入浴|にゅうよく}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after bathing)
- {入浴|にゅうよく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (currently bathing)
- {入浴|にゅうよく}⟦{介助|かいじょ}→介助：18633_kaijo⟧ (bathing assistance — nursing/care context)

In medical and caregiving contexts, {入浴|にゅうよく} is the standard term rather than the casual ⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧.
